get.description: Returns all medication requests/prescriptions for an encounter

post.description: Creates a new medication request/prescription for an encounter. An active allergy matching the drug (by ingredient or class) blocks the request with 409 MEDICATION_ALLERGY_BLOCKED unless a written overrideJustification (min 10 characters) is sent by a DOCTOR or ADMIN. Drug interactions never block and are returned as warnings.

get.description: Returns all exam analyses, optionally filtered by patient FHIR ID

post.description: Uploads a medical exam file for AI analysis with consent tracking and optional de-identification. The real file content is validated (magic bytes, structure, extension match) before anything is stored. When anonymize is true, embedded metadata (EXIF/XMP/IPTC, PNG text chunks, PDF info and XMP) is removed losslessly and a neutral file name is used for the AI call; text burned into the pixels is NOT removed and is reported in anonymizationReport.limitations. Error codes (HTTP 422): FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH, FILE_CORRUPTED, FILE_EMPTY.

parameters.description: Required true when anonymize is false
parameters.name: acknowledgeExternalProcessing

get.summary: List imaging studies for a patient

post.description: Uploads a DICOM imaging study for a patient. The DICOM header is read to fill StudyInstanceUID, modality, study date, accession number and series/instance UIDs, and the file is rejected when it belongs to a different patient (422 DICOM_PATIENT_MISMATCH) or was already uploaded (409 DICOM_DUPLICATE_INSTANCE). Title and modality are optional fallbacks; the DICOM modality wins when both are present.

parameters.description: Study title (derived from the DICOM header when empty)
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Fallback modality (e.g., CT, MR, XR) used only when the DICOM header has none
parameters.name: modality

get.description: Returns a chronological feed merging the patient's Encounter, Observation, Condition, AllergyIntolerance, MedicationRequest, DiagnosticReport and ImagingStudy records, ordered by recorded time (newest first) with cursor pagination. When some resource types cannot be loaded, the rest is returned and partial.failedTypes lists the unavailable types. Defaults to the last 6 months.

parameters.description: Window start (ISO date or RFC3339). Defaults to 6 months before now
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Window end (ISO date or RFC3339). Defaults to now
parameters.name: to
